text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Instead of just reading words, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind them. This technology powers many everyday tools, such as online translation services that convert text between languages. It also drives sentiment analysis, which determines whether a piece of writing expresses a positive, negative, or neutral feeling. Additionally, NLP is the brain behind chatbots, which can answer customer questions or hold simple conversations. By combining grammar rules with machine learning, NLP makes it possible for computers to interact with us in a more natural and useful way.
